priority_pilot: normal three legacy/legacy pairs, then high three legacy/legacy pairs; retain high only if median of six scenario spreads decreases
priority_pilot_comparison: use first member of each pair as three independent legacy runs; all six scenarios and both priority groups must be clean
rationale: quiet-probe clean round boundary points mostly 2-19%; polluted boundary points 44-81%; mean 20 and three successive points above 35 separate sustained external contention without rejecting an isolated short spike. Process-tree CPU is subtracted from system busy CPU on the same machine-wide denominator. Missing samples invalidate a run.
pair_policy: A1 B1 A2 B2 A3 B3; contaminated A or B invalidates both; rejected raw data retained in coverage; no cross-set stitching
stability: throughput max/min-1 < 10%; S2/S3 per-run mean ratio to own S1 then median; selected throughput row stays intact
candidate_thresholds: unchanged R4 preregistered.json; target >=2us or >=5%, others regression <=3%, spread <10%
